title: Afroman - Will You Help Me Repair My Door (OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO)
summary: Afroman's music video for a song about police damaging his door, built from home security footage of an officers' raid on his house.
why: Referenced in stories about the raid and the lawsuit as the source video, showing the footage and his response.

quote.text: It's worth watching the original video, it shows the officers damaging his property, eating his cake and doing various other questionable things
